args.command: export DISPLAY=:0; echo '=== windows ==='; command -v wmctrl >/dev/null 2>&1 && wmctrl -l || true; if ! command -v wmctrl >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n apt-get update -qq && sudo -n DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends wmctrl; fi; wmctrl -k on; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'DESKTOP_SHOWN=YES'; echo 'VT=3'; echo 'WINDOW_MANAGER=OPENBOX'

meta.summary: Show Mini GUI desktop by minimizing all windows
